description.value:
When you apply a rune to a foe, it reveals something about them to you. Trace a Rune onto an adjacent enemy and then attempt a skill check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Recall Knowledge] about that target. If you succeed, you leverage this knowledge when you invoke any of your runes on that target; that target takes a –1 status penalty to saving throws against your invocations for 1 minute.

If you use Edifying Trace on another enemy, the effect ends for the previous enemy.
